notes.title: September 24th, 2025 - Playtest Patch v0.4.4
notes.notes:
Howdy gunslingers!



We can’t thank y’all enough for your feedback on our playtest. Thanks to all your sharp eyes and quick wits, we’ve already fixed many bugs and added improvements based on your feedback.



The playtest will officially be closing on October 8th so make sure to saddle up and share your thoughts in the Tombwater Discord before then! All you need to do is click the "Join the Playtest" button on the store page for access.


Patch NotesNew Features
New heavy weapon, "Hitchin' Post", added to shop at Tombwater Station.

New spell “Sculpture Garden” available in a previously unfinished basement in Canyon Settlement.

Key questgivers can now mark maps to indicate quest locations.
Bug Fixes
Fixed the respawn error when the gunslinger’s real body dies while possessing a skeleton with Wraith Shot.

Reduced magnification/overlap of certain sound effects.

Catalina can no longer get stuck mid-dash during the Sewer fight.

Players can no longer shoot through the fence to kill the Raven Hunter early.

Dynamite now displays the correct inventory amounts when upgrading with Emmaline.

Fixed minor lighting issues with a torch in the Wraith Shot temple.

Resolved issues with the Quickswap menu UI.
Other Changes/Improvements
Added creaky SFX to the windmill interior in Canyon Settlement.

Added interactable signposts to certain crossroads to aid in navigation.

Slightly nerfed Big Clown enemies and the Acolyte guarding the Silverbolt spell eye.

The bell puzzle tent in the Circus now locks players in until the puzzle is solved.

Added visual cues in the Central District to aid navigation.

Adjusted some burnable bushes in Canyon Floor to require Wraith Shot, encouraging players to learn the ability instead of relying solely on fire spells.



Once again, a huge thanks for riding along with our playtest! If you’ve already played, we’d love for you to take another spin and let us know what you think of the new changes. Now is also a great time to invite a friend to the playtest and make sure you’re in our Discord. We’re so excited for our launch on November 12th and for y’all to experience the full game. 


Stay safe and be wary of the madness.



- The Tombwater Team

notes.title: Cowboy soulslike Tombwater gets a release date, and its cursed town ain't big enough for both you and some horrific hombres
notes.notes:
Yee-haw. Excuse me, I meant to say that wild west soulslike metroidvania Tombwater has walked into the saloon and ordered a release date. 'I'll have November 12th, 2025', it growled, while flashing its big iron at everyone in the watering hole to show it meant business.
Originally roaming the plains of Itch.io, this funky-looking game comes from Max Mraz, developer of Ocean's Heart and Bloodborne tribute Yarntown, and Jake Wagner. The duo have trained their six-shooters on Steam, where you can already find a demo to check out.

notes.title: July 8th, 2025 - Demo Patch v0.3.4
notes.notes:
Howdy gunslingers!



We’re still hard at work getting Tombwater ready for its full release. In the meantime, we’ve rolled out some updates to make the demo experience even better. If you have any feedback that is not listed here, please let us know in the Steam Discussions tab or in the Midwest Games Discord. 


Patch NotesNew Features
Expanded and reworked layout of Presidio Alto

Select weapons now feature special move "Weapon Art," which costs a small amount of Madness per use (test it out with LB!)

Revamped the Madness system: 

Exceeding your Madness cap now prevents the use of casting spells and Weapon Arts until you rest at a campfire

The Madness cap can be increased as you progress through the game
Bug Fixes
Added a version control checker

Fixed a crash related to control remapping 

Overall improvements to the remapping system 
Known Issue
The puzzle in the new area of Presidio Alto can be exploited by spamming the switches - this shouldn’t block progress, but it’s on our radar



We’re so darn grateful to everyone who’s played the demo and shared feedback - you are a huge help in making Tombwater the best it can be. We’ve got some exciting news coming, so stay tuned! 


- The Tombwater Team

notes.title: May 14th, 2025 - Demo Patch v0.2.3
notes.notes:
Howdy gunslingers!

As you may have realized, Tombwater is a town enveloped in madness and evil. And we would be mad to not listen to your feedback! We have implemented a few changes and bug fixes that will improve the demo experience. If you have any feedback that is not listed here, please let us know in the Steam Discussions tab or in the Midwest Games Discord. 

Patch Notes
Changes

 Nerf for Blood Rain spell damage output
 Improvements for M/KB controls

 Changed "Attack" to Left Mouse
 Changed "Fire" to Right Mouse
 Changed "Wraith Shot" to Middle/Side Mouse
 Changed "Pause/Unpause" to ESC
 Changed "Cancel" to Tab/Backspace
 Arrow keys are now hard bound to navigation controls in addition to WASD (WASD can be rebound, Arrow keys cannot due to a limitation of the engine)
 Added a visible cursor to assist in aiming using the Mouse  
Bug Fixes

 Fixed issue where the UI was displaying generic control prompts instead of Xbox/PS4 specific
 Fixed issue where firing the gun then rapidly changing screens can disable gun use
 Fixed issue where dying before picking up the Spanish Fort key causes the key to disappear
 Fixed unintended inputs for confirming purchases in a shop
 Fixed issue where the player can move during the class selection screen, resulting in re-triggering the cutscene and all kinds of funky issues

We are grateful for all the support that we have received on the demo! Reminder, the demo is really just a small dungeon in the greater world. There is so much more freedom to roam in the overworld coming later this year. Stay safe out there. Avoid the madness.

- The Tombwater Team
